outcome: S/D ratio of umbilical artery flow
cohort: 106 women with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy
finding: The combination of magnesium sulfate, phentolamine, and nifedipine was more effective than magnesium sulfate alone at improving hemodynamic indexes, 24-hour urinary protein levels, clinical efficacy, adverse drug reactions, and maternal and neonatal outcomes in women with hypertensive disorder complicating pregnancy.
